notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Thopters.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Wildwood Mentor using Thopter Squadron's last ability any number of times.
